capabilities: Explore notes in an interactive force-directed graph built from resolved internal links
Search filenames, paths, aliases and tags, and filter by folder, tag or connected notes
Expand incoming and outgoing link neighborhoods to a configurable depth of 1-3
Preview and open notes from graph nodes with native Markdown rendering
Create, rename/move, link and trash notes from the graph with confirmation
disambiguation: Not the third-party Knowledge Atlas plugin; it installs to its own directory and the README warns never to overwrite that plugin's files.
extras: Community-directory review is automated only; the README documents manual installation and warns not to overwrite the similarly named Knowledge Atlas plugin. Makes no network requests and collects no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian's graph view is for visualizing links, but users also want to search, filter, preview and edit notes directly inside a graph.
summary: Interactive force-directed graph of vault notes with search, folder/tag filtering, neighborhood expansion, previews and note management.
